meta.name: RBR
meta.description: Red Bull Racing — the Classic kerb red × brand yellow signature, on toned-down navy.
meta.author: 주인
meta.base: Red Bull Racing livery palette. Navy #0a1128 + kerb red #e84a55 + RB yellow #ffd84d + chequer white #ffffff.
meta.philosophy: Three brand accents: kerb red (active/selected/current), RB yellow (alerts/notifications/cursor), chequer white (functions/methods). Code scans visually as a red/yellow/white trio — the same three colors that own the Red Bull Racing livery. Other colors stay deliberately pastel so the trio dominates. Magenta slot is neutral grey so numbers/constants get visual weight without color noise.
design_rules: Red is reserved for 'this is the selected/active thing' — exactly one per viewport.
Yellow is reserved for 'attention needed now' — notifications, warnings, cursor position.
Pure white is the function accent — function and method names read as the third dominant color in any code buffer.
Green/blue/cyan stay pastel to preserve visual hierarchy — they should never compete with the trio.
Magenta slot is intentionally neutral grey: numbers and constants get visual weight without color noise.
Background navy is low-saturation so the trio pops without harshness.

brand._comment: Three Red Bull Racing signature colors form the trio that dominates the buffer. Other accents stay pastel.

ansi._comment: ANSI 0-15. Red slot = kerb red, yellow slot = RB yellow.

semantic._comment: Classic signature: red = primary/selected, yellow = attention/notification.
semantic._git: Git status. Deleted uses kerb red bright, modified uses RB yellow.
